url.description: The deployment's public URL (http://localhost:<port> unless set).

port.description: The port this process serves on.

data.description: Where this machine keeps the app's own files (ideas' files, without a bucket).

trusted_proxies.description: The reverse proxies (load balancers) in front of the app, IPs or CIDR ranges, whose X-Forwarded-For is believed.

endpoint.description: Its API, like http://127.0.0.1:6420. In development, without it, RivetKit starts an engine itself.

pool.description: The node pool this process joins: default for the app, the directory's for a directory process.

node_version.description: The node version the engine places actors by: the build's own unless set, the same on every machine.

token_file.description: A file holding engine.token, by its full path (/run/secrets/token), in place of the secret itself

pool.description: The directory's pool: its own nodes' (a pool of its own), or the app's unless set.

calls.description: How many calls this node sends the directory at once (actors/limit.ts).

secret.description: Signs cookies and encrypts the signing keys: a secret, at least 32 characters, required in production.

personal_tokens.description: Who may use personal tokens: on, admins or off.

scim_token.description: The identity provider's SCIM bearer token: a secret, at least 32 characters; SCIM is off without it.

domains.description: The email domains that can sign in with it (required with it on).

auto_create.description: Make an account for someone new; off refuses them until someone adds them.

client_secret_file.description: A file holding auth.sso.oidc.client_secret, by its full path (/run/secrets/client_secret), in place of the secret itself

metadata.description: A file with the provider's metadata XML.

sp_key.description: Files with our key and certificate (PEM), for providers that want signed requests.

secret_file.description: A file holding auth.secret, by its full path (/run/secrets/secret), in place of the secret itself

scim_token_file.description: A file holding auth.scim_token, by its full path (/run/secrets/scim_token), in place of the secret itself

client_hosts.description: The only hosts MCP clients' metadata documents may be on, like claude.ai; any unless set.

mode.description: sendmail: through this machine's sendmail; log: sign-in codes in the server's log. SMTP when smtp_url is set.

smtp_url.description: smtps://user:password@host:465 or smtp://user:password@host:587: a secret, as it holds the password.

from.description: The sender of sign-in codes: "Ideation Factory <sign-in@example.com>".

notify_from.description: The sender of notifications (from's unless set).

notifications.description: off: no notification emails (sign-in codes still go).

smtp_url_file.description: A file holding email.smtp_url, by its full path (/run/secrets/smtp_url), in place of the secret itself

endpoint.description: The store's URL, for anything but AWS (http://seaweedfs:8333).

access_key_id.description: Its key, allowed only this bucket; without them, Bun's S3_* or AWS_* variables.

virtual_hosted.description: The bucket in the hostname, as AWS prefers; in the path when off.

secret_access_key_file.description: A file holding files.s3.secret_access_key, by its full path (/run/secrets/secret_access_key), in place of the secret itself

max_idea_bytes.description: The largest idea, all its files together, in bytes

editors.description: The most windows editing one draft at once; past it, a window opens the draft read-only, still live. Every keystroke and caret move goes to everyone in the draft, so the work grows with the square of this: measure it on your hardware with the draft crowd load test (packages/load).

caret_ms.description: How often, at most, a window sends where its caret is, in milliseconds

keep_steps.description: How many of a file’s typing steps are kept for a window catching up after a dropped connection, at least (this many, or keep_minutes, whichever keeps more). Further behind, the window saves its page block by block.

keep_minutes.description: How long a file’s typing steps are kept for catching up, in minutes

snapshot_every.description: How often a file’s document is stored whole, in steps: an idea waking up replays at most this many

restore_quiet_minutes.description: How long the draft is quiet before a restore point is kept, in minutes (one is also kept when someone who changed it leaves, and before an agent’s change, a discard, an overwrite or a restore)

restore_keep_mb.description: How much of the draft’s restore points an idea keeps, in MB: past it, the oldest are dropped (their labels stay, marked no longer kept)

dir.description: The built web app (the web package's dist unless set).

dev_url.description: Vite's dev server, while working on the web app (bun run dev sets it).
